patch_description: All top variants plateau near min_area ≈ 0.03, suggesting the coordinate descent gets trapped in a local basin. Following the recommendation, I add a final structured escape phase: compute a per-vertex "binding score" (mean of the 20 smallest triangle areas containing each vertex), pick the binding vertex from the smallest triangle and swap it with a non-binding vertex, then re-polish with a short hard-min refinement. Keep the swap only if the hard minimum improves. This reuses the existing vectorized area machinery and stays deterministic.
